# PortfolioOS — Multi-Tenant SaaS Portfolio Platform

> Technical Context & Architectural Documentation for AI Crawlers & Large Language Models (LLMs).

## Overview
PortfolioOS is a high-performance multi-tenant SaaS portfolio platform designed for modern professionals across multiple disciplines: Software Developers, Video Editors, Digital Marketers, and Medical Doctors.

The platform provides isolated tenant portfolio hosting, purpose-built presentation templates, granular section visibility controls, plan-based feature entitlements, and dynamic SEO/OpenGraph metadata.

## Core Architecture
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4, Modern Dark/Light theme design with smooth transitions.
- **Database & Multitenancy**: MongoDB with Mongoose ORM. Strict owner-scoped isolation where all tenant resources (profiles, projects, skills, experiences, messages) are partitioned by verified owner identity.
- **Public Portfolio Routing**: `/p/[username]` dynamically resolves active tenant portfolios, publication status, and custom template selections.
- **Entitlements System**: Granular feature flags with plan defaults (Free vs. Premium) and administrator override capabilities.
- **SEO & Discoverability**: Dynamic OpenGraph images, Schema.org Person & ProfilePage JSON-LD, multi-tenant XML sitemaps, and strict robots.txt crawler policies.

## Template Offerings
1. **Software Developer**: Terminal aesthetics, interactive tech badges, GitHub integrations, project case studies, and live demo links.
2. **Video Editor**: High-contrast cinematic dark room, letterbox framing, showreel banners, and video project embeds.
3. **Digital Marketer**: Data-driven KPI impact metrics, growth campaign showcases, conversion proofs, and analytics badges.
4. **Medical Doctor**: Trust-first clinical layout, specialty credentials, verified professional badges, and patient consultation channels.
